name: Jörgen Warborn - Article 2 – alinéa 1 – point 2; Article 19 bis - Am 35
title: REPORT on the proposal for a directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directives 2006/43/EC, 2013/34/EU, (EU) 2022/2464 and (EU) 2024/1760 as regards certain corporate sustainability reporting and due diligence requirements
part_text: (a a) in paragraph 1, the following subparagraph is added: ‘Undertakings that are a financial holding undertaking as defined in Article 2(15), shall be exempted from carrying out the obligations under this Directive.’;
